messages.subject: Brightwater v Caldervale — CMC order and directions
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia, Liam,

The CMC was yesterday. The sealed order is attached. Headlines: Extended Disclosure (Model C) by 15 May; the availability monitoring data and methodology note exchanged by 29 May; witness statements by 26 June; one IT-measurement expert each, reports by 31 July; trial window from 12 January 2027, 4 days. The disclosure and expert stages are where we win the availability point. Costs of the CMC are costs in the case.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
